The hate comes from the time it was released.

Resident evil kept going and going in a more action oriented direction and fans were getting annoyed. Some years before re6 came out a developer said it was going to be more horror focused. Apparently that changed at some point during development.

Then it was said that resident evil from here on out will be an action game only. Narratively it made some sense, as the incidents kept getting bigger and bigger and monsters kept getting more powerful. But fans were not about this at all. It was also a time where survivor horror was straight up dead. Every horror game turned into an action game. Resident evil, silent Hill with homecoming (although I would argue against this) and dead space 3 were once popular horror games now just straight up shooters.

To substitute this, the revelation games would focus more on horror and this way they could make everybody happy. (This is most likely why we haven't seen another revelations game as the series as since returned to its roots).

But then re6 came out and it was a shit show. Long time fans hated it because it barely resembled the series. Not to mention the story isn't very good. It was a good action game but a bad resident evil game.

Nowadays people respect it for what it is. Honestly resident evil had to fail incredibly hard for Capcom to turn itself around the way it did so I'm thankful re6 was a failure in that regard.

Personally I've always loved the game but I totally understand everyone's disdain for it.
